items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
items.summary: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

items.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
items.summary: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

items.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
items.summary: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

items.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
items.summary: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

items.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
items.summary: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum…

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
items.summary: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%.

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.
